title: 新粗野主义
description: 黑框描到底，阴影是一块偏移的黑。一支 20 秒短片，全片只有一条物理——阴影长度就是高度：海报炸成十三颗键帽；一支笔先画框，注册表单从框里一个个长出来；卡片抬起来摊成阶梯；二十颗按钮的按压像水波一样扩散，再从 1952 年的清水混凝土、2014 年的粗野主义网页一路变回今天的界面；最后落进网页和手机 App。

descriptionEn: Black borders on everything; the shadow is a solid offset block. A 20-second film built on one piece of physics — shadow length is height: a poster shatters into thirteen keycaps; a pen draws each frame and a sign-up form grows out of the borders; a card lifts and fans into a staircase; twenty buttons ripple when pressed, turn into 1952 raw concrete and a 2014 brutalist web page, and come back as today's UI — then a landing page and a phone app assemble layer by layer.

title: 装饰艺术
description: 先立一条中轴，阶梯、放射和三线从中轴往两边同时长出来；金色是材质，只给线。一支 20 秒一镜到底的短片：光顺着海报的金线跑一圈，镜头推进拱窗、穿过一串三线拱门；玫瑰窗变成十二瓣万花筒，再塌成地平线上的太阳；夜景天际线三层纵深升起，探照灯成对交叉，镜头贴着主楼一路升到尖顶；五条规则翻转着飞来；最后海报一笔一笔重新长回去。
descriptionEn: Draw one central axis, then grow steps, sunbursts and triple lines out of it on both sides at once; gold is a material, used only for lines. A 20-second single-shot film: light races along the poster's gold lines, the camera pushes through the arch into a tunnel of triple-line portals, a rose window turns into a twelve-fold Busby Berkeley kaleidoscope that collapses into a sun on the horizon, a night skyline rises in three layers of depth under crossing searchlights while the camera rides the hero tower up to its spire, five rule plaques flip in from the distance, and the poster redraws itself stroke by stroke.

title: 液态玻璃
description: 玻璃不发光，只把后面的东西弯过来：折射量 = 边缘的坡度。一支 20 秒短片，同一滴玻璃从头接力到尾：落下激起涟漪，镜头两次穿过玻璃，从 Aqua 到液态玻璃的二十五年，靠近融合、按钮展开成菜单，再落进 3D 手机与网页；五条规则由放大镜逐条读过，最后升回开场。
descriptionEn: Glass does not glow; it bends what is behind it, with refraction following the slope of the edge. One droplet carries this 20-second film: a rippling impact, two journeys through glass, twenty-five years from Aqua to Liquid Glass, merging drops and a button that grows into a menu, then a 3D phone and browser. A magnifier reads five practical rules before the droplet returns to the opening.

title: 微缩景观
description: 把世界切成一块底座，一块块搭出来，再用移轴把它变小。一支 20 秒短片：街角、房间剖面与模型铁路在同一张桌上逐块搭起，收成手机界面，再一起入夜；台灯熄灭后，零件倒着飞回开场。
descriptionEn: Cut the world into a block on a base, build it piece by piece, then make it small with tilt-shift. In this 20-second film, a street corner, a cutaway room and a model railway assemble on one table, become a phone interface and turn to night. The lamp clicks off, then every piece rewinds to the opening.
